info.name: Training Module
info.description:
Full training module API — module CRUD, parts, questions, org-scoping access, learner assignments, progress tracking, and reports.

**Base URL:** `{{baseUrl}}` → e.g. `http://localhost:6830/api/v1`

All requests require `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`.

**Variables to set before running:**
| Variable | Example |
|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | `http://localhost:6830/api/v1` |
| `token` | `<JWT>` |
| `moduleId` | `<TrainingModule ObjectId>` |
| `partId` | `<TrainingModulePart ObjectId>` |
| `questionId` | `<TrainingModuleQuestion ObjectId>` |
| `accessId` | `<TrainingModuleAccess ObjectId>` |
| `assignmentId` | `<ModuleAssignment ObjectId>` |
| `clientId` | `<Client ObjectId>` |
| `branchId` | `<Branch ObjectId>` |
| `roleId` | `<Roles ObjectId>` |
| `learnerId` | `<User ObjectId>` |

item.name: Modules
item.description:
Create and manage training module definitions.

Modules are content-only — client/branch/role scoping is managed separately via Module Access. Only published modules can be assigned to learners.

request.description:
Creates a draft module with title only.

Required: `title`
Auto-generated: `uid` (MOD_timestamp), `slug` (from title), `status` defaults to `draft`

Creates a module with all optional fields.

`status` — `draft` | `published` | `archived` (default: `draft`)
`metadata` — free-form Mixed field for any extra data

Roles: admin, manager

Returns a paginated list of modules via advancedResults middleware.
Supports filter, select, sort, page, and limit query params.
Returns one module with populated virtuals: `parts`, `partsCount`, `questionsCount`, `avgQuestionsPerPart`, `isPublished`, `access`.
Publishes the module so it can be assigned to learners.

Send only the fields you want to change.

Roles: admin, manager

Permanently deletes a module.

Roles: admin only

Returns all assignments created by the authenticated user with per-learner progress breakdown.

Roles: admin, manager

item.name: Module Access (Scoping)
item.description:
Admin assigns a module to one or more (client / branch / role) combinations.

This controls which organisations see the module and auto-creates ModuleAssignment records for all matching active users.

`roles: []` on a scope means all roles within that client/branch are permitted.

item.name: Assign Access — single scope, all roles

request.description:
`roles: []` — open to all roles within this client/branch.

Side effect: every active user matching `clientBelongs` + `branchBelongs` is automatically inserted as a `ModuleAssignment` (pending, duplicates skipped).

Response includes `autoAssigned` count.

Roles: admin only

item.name: Assign Access — single scope, specific roles

request.description:
`roles` — array of `Roles` ObjectIds. Only users whose `User.role` maps to one of these role names will be auto-assigned.

Roles: admin only

Pass an array to assign multiple scopes in one call.

Duplicate scopes (same module + client + branch) are silently skipped.

Response: `{ inserted, skipped, autoAssigned }`
- `inserted` — new TrainingModuleAccess docs created
- `skipped` — duplicate scopes ignored
- `autoAssigned` — ModuleAssignment docs auto-created for matching users

Lists all client/branch/role scopes assigned to this module.

Roles: admin, manager

Removes a single access scope. Set `accessId` to the `_id` returned by the GET endpoint.

Roles: admin only

item.name: Parts
item.description:
Parts are the content units inside a module — each has a video and a set of questions.

Part titles must be unique within the same module (allowed to repeat across different modules).

request.description:
Creates a part. `video.provider` and `video.durationSec` are auto-fetched for YouTube and Vimeo URLs.

Required: `title`

`minWatchPercent` — learner must watch this % before attempting questions (default 80)
`passAllRequired` — all questions must be answered correctly (default true)
`maxRetries` — 0 = unlimited retries (default 0)
`estimatedTimeMin` — display hint only (default 5)
`order` — display order within module (default 0)

Title must be unique within the same module.

Roles: admin, manager
For Cloudinary or AWS S3 URLs, provider is detected automatically but `durationSec` defaults to 0 (no external API call).
Returns all parts for a module sorted by `order` ascending. Each part includes its populated `questions` array.
Returns a single part with its populated `questions` array.

When `video.url` is provided, metadata (provider, durationSec) is re-fetched automatically.

Roles: admin, manager
Update part settings without touching the video.

Permanently deletes the part.

Roles: admin, manager

item.name: Questions
item.description: Questions belong to a part. Option identifier is `key` (A/B/C/D) — not `label`. `correctAnswers` is an array of `key` values.

body.raw:
{
  "text": "What is the minimum PPE required on a construction site?",
  "type": "single",
  "options": [
    { "key": "A", "text": "Hard hat only" },
    { "key": "B", "text": "Hard hat, vest, and steel-capped boots" },
    { "key": "C", "text": "No PPE required" },
    { "key": "D", "text": "Gloves only" }
  ],
  "correctAnswers": ["B"],
  "explanation": "Full PPE is always required on construction sites.",
  "points": 2,
  "order": 1
}

request.description:
Creates a question and appends it to the part's `questions` array.

Required: `text`

`type` — `single` | `multiple` | `boolean` (default: `single`)
`options[].key` — the identifier referenced in `correctAnswers` (A, B, C, D …)
`options[].text` — display text shown to the learner
`correctAnswers` — array of `key` values that are correct
`explanation` — shown to learner after submission (optional)
`points` — score value for a correct answer (default 1)
`order` — display order within the part (default 0)

Roles: admin, manager

body.raw:
{
  "text": "Which of the following are valid fire evacuation steps? (select all that apply)",
  "type": "multiple",
  "options": [
    { "key": "A", "text": "Sound the alarm" },
    { "key": "B", "text": "Use the lift" },
    { "key": "C", "text": "Proceed to the assembly point" },
    { "key": "D", "text": "Call the fire department" }
  ],
  "correctAnswers": ["A", "C", "D"],
  "explanation": "Never use the lift during a fire evacuation.",
  "points": 3,
  "order": 2
}

request.description: For `type: "multiple"`, `correctAnswers` contains all correct `key` values. When submitting answers, `selectedAnswer` should be a comma-separated string or an array.
Boolean questions use `key: "true"` and `key: "false"` as the option identifiers.

`correctAnswers` must reference existing `key` values in the question's `options` array.

Roles: admin, manager

item.name: Update Question — change points and order

request.description: Send only the fields you want to change.

Deletes the question document and removes its ObjectId from the parent part's `questions` array.

Roles: admin, manager

item.name: Learner Assignments
item.description:
Manager assigns a published module to specific learners.

Base: `{{baseUrl}}/training-assignments`

request.description:
Assigns a published module to one learner with no due date and unlimited attempts.

Module must have `status: "published"`.
Duplicate assignments are silently skipped (`skipped` count returned).
Learners whose role is not permitted by any access rule are counted as `roleBlocked`.

Roles: admin, manager

`learnerIds` — non-empty array of User ObjectIds (required)
`dueDate` — ISO 8601 date, optional
`maxAttempts` — 0 = unlimited (default 0)

Response:
```
{ inserted, skipped, roleBlocked, message }
```
- `inserted` — new assignments created
- `skipped` — already assigned
- `roleBlocked` — learners rejected due to role not in access rules
Returns all modules assigned to the authenticated learner, enriched with a live progress snapshot per module.

Returns all assignments the authenticated manager created with per-learner progress breakdown.

Roles: admin, manager

Admin sees all assignments. Managers see only assignments they created.

Supports `moduleId`, `learnerId`, `status` query filters.

Roles: admin, manager
Returns a single assignment. Accessible by the assigned learner, the assigner, or an admin.

Updates assignment status. Typically called by a scheduled job to mark overdue.

`status` — `pending` | `in-progress` | `completed` | `overdue`

Roles: admin, manager

Revokes the assignment and decrements `stats.assignedCount` on the module.

Only the assigner or an admin can revoke.

Roles: admin, manager

item.name: Learner Progress
item.description:
Learner-facing progress tracking — start a module, record video watch time, submit answers, complete.

Learner routes: `{{baseUrl}}/training-progress`
Admin/manager routes: `{{baseUrl}}/training-modules/:moduleId/...`

request.description:
Starts or resumes a module for the authenticated learner. Creates a `TrainingLearnerProgress` document if one does not exist.

Requires an active `ModuleAssignment` (status `pending` or `in-progress`) for this learner.
Also verifies the learner's role is still permitted by the module's access rules.

Returns the full progress document. Check `currentPartIndex` to resume at the correct part.

Returns the authenticated learner's progress for one module.

Returns `{ data: null }` if the learner has not started yet.
Returns all progress records for the authenticated learner across every assigned module.

Records how many seconds the learner has watched for a part.

`partId` — ObjectId of the part being watched (required)
`watchedSeconds` — seconds watched so far (required)
`durationSec` — total video duration in seconds (required)

Behaviour:
- `watchPercent` = `(watchedSeconds / durationSec) * 100`, clamped 0–100
- Watch records are **upserted** — the highest `watchedSeconds` is always kept
- `completed: true` is set when `watchPercent >= part.minWatchPercent`

Call this periodically as the learner watches (e.g. every 10 seconds).

Response returns the updated watch record for this part.

Submits answers for one part in the current attempt round.

`partId` — ObjectId of the part (required)
`answers` — non-empty array of answer objects (required)
`answers[].questionId` — ObjectId of the question
`answers[].selectedAnswer` — the option `key` the learner selected (e.g. `"B"`)

Response:
```
{
  results: [{ questionId, selectedAnswer, isCorrect, pointsEarned }],
  partScore: 0–100,
  passed: boolean,
  overallScore: 0–100,
  currentPartIndex: number
}
```

For `type: "multiple"` questions, `selectedAnswer` can be an array of key strings or a comma-separated string.

All selected keys must match `correctAnswers` exactly (order-independent) to be marked correct.

Finalises the module attempt. Calculates total score, sets `isPassed` (score >= passThreshold), and stamps `completedAt`.

Can only be called once per attempt round — returns `400` if already completed this round.

Response:
```
{ score, isPassed, passThreshold, completedAt }
```

Aggregated progress report across all learners. Managers see only their own assignments' learners.

Roles: admin, manager

Returns one row per learner for the given module with status, score, and attempt counts.

Roles: admin, manager

Grants the learner one additional attempt. Increments `attemptRound` and resets `currentPartIndex`, `score`, `isPassed`, `completedAt`, and `passedAt`.

`learnerId` — ObjectId of the learner (required)

Errors:
- `400` — max attempts reached (`assignment.maxAttempts > 0`)
- `404` — no assignment found for this learner

Roles: admin, manager

item.name: Reports
item.description:
Training analytics and KPI dashboards. All endpoints require admin or manager role.

Base: `{{baseUrl}}/training-reports`

request.description:
Returns system-wide KPI snapshot:

`totalModules` — all modules
`publishedModules` — published modules
`totalAssignments` — all assignments
`completionRate` — % assignments with a completed progress doc
`passRate` — % of completions that passed
`avgScore` — average score across all completed modules

Managers see data scoped to their own assignments only.
Returns a table of all modules with aggregated stats: assignment count, completion count, pass count, and average score.
Returns one row per learner showing all assigned modules and their completion/pass status.

Returns a detailed report for one module:

`summary` — totalLearners, completed, passed, avgScore
`questionBreakdown` — per-question correct/incorrect counts and difficulty score
